note: Full backup cannot omit new private volumes/host data. No Docker state in git. No destructive automatic migration; legacy SQLite preserved. Intelligence datastores covered in intelligence_selfhosted; unsupported automation listed in backup_unsupported_explicit.

volumes.name: postgres-data
volumes.holds: product rows, audit, policy, grants, channels, components, tasks, work, memory refs (threads themselves in Intelligence)

volumes.name: agent-workspace
volumes.holds: per-computer workspaces, per-bot folders, task artifacts, shell files
volumes.snapshot: volume copy / bind export (per-bot prefix, fstat bounds)

volumes.name: agent-profiles
volumes.omit_risk: loses logins; reset deletes this by design (operator danger)

host_binds.holds: model OAuth dir (OPENBOT_MODEL_OAUTH_FILE), token renewal (dir mount, not file mount)

home_owned.holds: pairing/sessions facade rows, legacy conversations/messages/artifacts, upstream_users + upstream_threads mapping tables
home_owned.snapshot: SQLite backup (existing home backup path); no erase

home_owned.holds: Intelligence threads/memory on HOME-OWNED self-hosted Intelligence deployment (not in Postgres, never managed cloud default)
home_owned.snapshot: Intelligence deployment backup per official chart/provisioner docs; operator action

for_C: Setup backup must include/EXPLICITLY BLOCK on all above; do not label old SQLite-only backup as covering Postgres/Intelligence/computer files.

intelligence_selfhosted.holds: threads/memory (durable), shared state, realtime sync; AG-UI events when objectStorage enabled

datastores.name: intelligence Postgres (>=14)
datastores.snapshot: managed backup or volume copy; migrations Job required on install

intelligence_selfhosted.snapshot: chart/managed backups per provisioner docs + deploy/upstream-intelligence-values.yaml (operator overlay); thread-culler CronJob stays DISABLED (destructive)
intelligence_selfhosted.for_C: backup must include all three when configured; never label SQLite-only backup as covering them

backup_unsupported_explicit: No automatic backup is implemented: snapshots are operator actions (pg_dump, volume copy, managed backups).
thread-culler CronJob is destructive cleanup and stays disabled; it is not a backup.
Without a configured Intelligence deployment there are no threads/memory to back up (NEEDS_INPUT, not silent loss).
